newsitem.title: USA: Carson sees nine-month sales, EPS rising.
newsitem.headline: Carson sees nine-month sales, EPS rising.

text.p: Carson Inc said late Thursday it expects to report an increase of 17.3 percent in its earnings for the nine months ended December 31, 1996, with an 18.6 percent gain in net sales.
The company said its proforma earnings for the nine-month period should be about $5.5 million, or $0.37 per share, compared with $4.7 million, or $0.31 per share, for the 1995 period.
It expects to report nine-month net sales of about $59.9 million, compared with $50.5 million in prior year's nine-month period, it said.
The company, which makes and markets ethnic hair care products, is changing to a calendar year basis for reporting operating results.
It attributed its projections to strong domestic sales and sharp sales increases internationally.
